mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no, o.item_id, o.student_id, o.amount, o.paid_amount, o.channel, o.status, o.transaction_no, o.expire_at, o.paid_at, o.closed_at, o.created_at, i.item_no, i.item_name, i.category, s.student_no, s.college, u.real_name AS student_name FROM payment_order o INNER JOIN payment_item i ON i.id = o.item_id INNER JOIN student s ON s.id = o.student_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_order SET status = 'PAID', paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, transaction_no = #{transactionNo}, paid_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 'PAYING' AND deleted = 0
UPDATE payment_order SET status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND expire_at < NOW() AND deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status <> 'CLOSED' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS receivable, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('PAID', 'PARTIAL_REFUND') THEN o.paid_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS received, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('PAID', 'PARTIAL_REFUND') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.student_id) AS student_count FROM payment_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0
AND o.item_id = #{itemId}

SELECT s.college, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS student_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status <> 'CLOSED' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS receivable, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('PAID', 'PARTIAL_REFUND') THEN o.paid_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS received FROM student s LEFT JOIN payment_order o ON o.student_id = s.id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.college ORDER BY receivable DESC

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(o.paid_at, '%Y-%m') AS stat_date,
DATE_FORMAT(o.paid_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_date,
COALESCE(SUM(o.paid_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS count FROM payment_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status IN ('PAID', 'PARTIAL_REFUND') AND o.paid_at IS NOT NULL
AND o.paid_at >= #{start}
AND o.paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date ASC
SELECT * FROM payment_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND channel = #{channel} AND status IN ('PAID', 'PARTIAL_REFUND') AND paid_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(paid_at) = #{billDate} ORDER BY id ASC
